s: a coffee bar hidden up a switch-back staircase inside a bike shop
w: Reached by climbing a narrow, switch-back staircase through the bike showroom of Bike Zone on St Michael's Street -- past the display models before you even see a menu -- this first-floor café is one of Oxford's genuinely well-kept secrets. Coffee, toasted sandwiches and banana bread served just off Cornmarket, entirely missed by anyone who doesn't already know to look up.
_facts: Located at 28-32 St Michael's Street, Oxford OX1 2EB, above Bike Zone cycle shop
Reached via a narrow first-floor staircase through the bike shop's display room
Serves coffee, toasted sandwiches and banana bread
Just off Cornmarket Street, Oxford's main central thoroughfare
